params.name: Rows
params.description: Number of quad divisions along the length (Z). More rows give a finer grid.

params.name: Columns
params.description: Number of quad divisions across the width (X). More columns give a finer grid.

params.name: Width
params.description: Size of the grid along X in world units.

params.name: Length
params.description: Size of the grid along Z in world units.

params.name: Center
params.description: Position of the grid's center in world units; the grid lies flat in the XZ plane through this point.
